lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular clusters of pixels are arranged in semi-regular horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The clusters increase in diameter and inter-centroid distance as they progress towards the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, frequently intersecting with the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a bright superior edge and shadowed inferior edge, extending from the post-branchial region towards the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. A small, elongated white feature is visible trailing from the distal ventral tip of the same pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Five vertically oriented branchial slits are clearly visible on the anterior flank, characterized by regular spacing and distinct internal shadow gradients.
